body.p: Use Explain commit with AI to generate a summary of all changes in a commit. This is useful when the commit message does not provide enough detail or you want a quick overview of what changed.

To explain commits with AI, follow these instructions:
To explain a single commit, on Git History, right-click a commit and select Explain commit with AI.
To explain multiple commits, select one or more commits. Right-click a selected commit and select Explain commits with AI
The AI Positron view opens and the assistant explains the commit.

fig.title: Explain Commit with AI on Git History

body.p: You can customize how commit explanations are generated in the Git Client AI preferences. For example, you can add project-specific instructions and save them in an project file so the same guidance is shared across a team.
